title: One resource hierarchy, two kinds of rules flowing down it

layers.name: Organisation
items: Organization Policy: which configurations are allowed
Usually does not touch existing resources

layers.name: Folders
items: A role granted here reaches every project below

layers.name: Projects
items: Removing a grant does nothing if the folder grants it

layers.name: Resources
items: Effective access: union of its own and every ancestor's allow policy
A deny policy beats any allow, even Owner

caption: Allow grants and policies flow from top to bottom; a lower level cannot remove what a higher level grants.
